species.selection_note: Research-grade observation in Kiso, Nagano, Japan. Select East Asian species for Korean 꽃송이버섯, not European S. crispa. Korea Forest Service explicitly maps crispa -> latifolia. Original photo downloaded unchanged; reference only.

Research-grade iNaturalist observation in Budapest with current taxon Collybia sordida. Korean NIBR lists old synonym Lepista sordida as 자주방망이버섯아재비, distinct from L. nuda 민자주방망이버섯. Interpret user abbreviation 자주방망이 as sordida, with naming ambiguity made explicit. Commons photo original returned HTTP403; independent licensed primary iNaturalist photo selected instead. Reference only.

French exact-species research-grade observation; choose black winter truffle rather than white truffle or Tuber aestivum. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

German exact-species research-grade observation; excludes California B. edulis grandedulis variety shown in other search results. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Bulgarian research-grade observation explicitly identified as M. esculenta; not a false morel or a North American substitute. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

English research-grade observation; avoids geographical species ambiguity of similar North American black trumpets. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Research-grade primary photo of the giant puffball. Young pale whole fruit body should guide the game art, not a mature broken spore sac. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Mexican research-grade exact-species photo. Preserve real blue zones and morphology; not a generic blue toadstool. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Research-grade observation of the white-net veiled stinkhorn. Yellow-net Phallus species are not substituted. Korean NIBR maps 망태버섯 to P. indusiatus. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Korean forest/BRIS sources identify 먹물버섯 as C. comatus. It is the shaggy inkcap, not smooth gray Coprinopsis atramentaria. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Exact parasite taxon research-grade observation; the visible fruit body is the infected Russula/Lactarius host, not an independent standard-shaped Hypomyces cap. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Photograph of taxonomically studied Thai collection MFU16-2668. Exact original JPEG extracted from the deposited CC BY4 publication PDF (page11/Figure2), without repainting or changing pixels. Select East Asian reishi under G. sichuanense / G. lingzhi naming; European G. lucidum sensu stricto is excluded. A 2023 type-material study treats G. lingzhi as a later synonym of G. sichuanense. Commons image CDN returned429; source publisher deposited PDF accessed normally at Zenodo.

Research-grade exact-species photo. Many differently colored thin fans are characteristic; avoid the thicker orange pore surface of lookalikes. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Original photograph in Figure1 of a primary taxonomy/phylogeny paper. Figure contains six species: A alpinus, B lonicerinus, C sanghuang, D baumii, E vaninii, F lonicericola. C is the required exact species; other panels must not be used as sanghuang. Exact original JPEG extracted unchanged from CC BY article PDF page6. Commons exact-species CC0 photos identified but CDN429. Museum holotype source also verified identity; museum canDownload=false so museum photos were not downloaded.

Choose C. militaris as the exact artistic species rather than Ophiocordyceps sinensis or zombie-ant fungus. Primary research-grade photo. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.

Research-grade species observation. Game reference is the black sterile chaga mass, not the rare resupinate fertile fruit body. Downloaded unchanged as anatomy reference only. Photo license confirmed through public API; community research-grade identification is not a genetic identification.
